(Columbus, Ohio) | college = * [[Xavier Musketeers men's basketball|Xavier]] (2023–2025) * [[Texas Longhorns men's basketball|Texas]] (2025–2026) | highlights = * Second-team [[List of All-SEC men's basketball teams|All-SEC]] (2026) * [[Southeastern Conference|SEC]] Newcomer of the Year (2026) * [[Big East Conference|Big East]] All-Freshman team (2024) }} '''Dailyn Lamont Swain''' (born July 15, 2005) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Xavier Musketeers men's basketball|Xavier Musketeers]] and [[Texas Longhorns men's basketball|Texas Longhorns]]. ==Early life and high school== Swain attended [[Columbus Africentric Early College]] in [[Columbus, Ohio]]. He started on the basketball team since his freshman season and finished as the team's all-time leading scorer with 1,509 points. Swain earned two consecutive Division III district Player of the Year honors and was named first-team all-state. He finished fourth in the voting for [[Ohio Mr. Basketball]].{{cite web |last1=DiRenna |first1=Frank |title='It would mean everything': Swain hopes to lead Africentric to boys basketball state title |url=https://www.dispatch.com/story/sports/high-school/basketball/2023/03/17/dailyn-swain-columbus-africentric-ohsaa-ohio-state-basketball-title/70005401007/ |website=The Columbus Dispatch |access-date=25 September 2024}} Swain also played for the varsity tennis team for his final two seasons.{{cite web |last1=Dermer |first1=Shelby |title='He plays an exciting brand of basketball.' What freshman Dailyn Swain brings to Xavier |url=https://www.cincinnati.com/story/sports/college/xavier/2023/07/27/he-can-just-flat-out-play-what-dailyn-swain-brings-to-xavier-hoops/70471179007/ |website=The Enquirer |access-date=25 September 2024}} Swain played for All Ohio Red on the [[Nike Elite Youth Basketball League]] (EYBL) circuit, where he averaged 10.3 points, 4.2 rebounds, 3.5 assists and 2.1 steals per game.{{cite web |last1=Shaw |first1=Jamie |title=INTEL: Xavier trending for four-star Dailyn Swain |url=https://www.on3.com/news/xavier-trending-for-four-star-dailyn-swain-over-ohio-state/ |website=On3 |access-date=25 September 2024 |date=29 August 2022}} ==College career== ===Xavier=== On September 2, 2022, Swain announced he was committing to [[Xavier University]]. He also had offers from [[Arizona State University]], [[University of Arkansas]], [[Clemson University]] and [[Ohio State University]].{{cite web |last1=Ulrey |first1=Jarrod |title=Africentric boys basketball standout Dailyn Swain commits to Xavier |url=https://www.dispatch.com/story/sports/high-school/basketball/2022/09/03/dailyn-swain-xavier-university-cincinnati-columbus-africentric-ohio-high-school-boys-basketball/65471183007/ |website=The Columbus Dispatch |access-date=25 September 2024}} Swain was one of three four-star recruits to sign a national letter of intent to Xavier as a member of the 2023 recruiting class. On March 6, 2024, Swain was sidelined indefinitely after undergoing a successful [[appendectomy]].{{cite web |last1=Dermer |first1=Shelby |title=Xavier freshman Dailyn Swain out indefinitely after appendectomy |url=https://www.cincinnati.com/story/sports/college/xavier/2024/03/06/xavier-freshman-dailyn-swain-out-indefinitely-after-appendectomy/72855349007/ |website=The Enquirer |access-date=25 September 2024}} On March 10, 2024, it was announced that Swain earned [[Big East Conference]] All-Freshman Team honors. He led all six Xavier freshmen in minutes at 18.9 per game before having his season shut down. Swain tied for third on the team in steals at 1.03 steals per game. He tied his career-high for rebounds with six in two of his last three games.{{cite web |title=Quincy Olivari, Dailyn Swain And Trey Green Earn Postseason BIG EAST Honors |url=https://goxavier.com/news/2024/3/10/mens-basketball-quincy-olivari-dailyn-swain-and-trey-green-earn-postseason-big-east-honors |website=Xavier University Athletics |access-date=25 September 2024 }} On July 1, 2024, Swain was cleared for all basketball-related activities.{{cite web |last1=Dermer |first1=Shelby |title=Xavier misses out on Harrell, who commits to Providence; Roddie Anderson will redshirt |url=https://www.cincinnati.com/story/sports/college/xavier/2024/07/01/roddie-anderson-redshirt-at-xavier-musketeers-big-east-basketball-schedule-rankings/74275129007/ |website=The Enquirer |access-date=25 September 2024}} On March 24, 2025, Swain announced he would be entering the [[NCAA transfer portal]].{{cite web |last1=Kosko |first1=Nick |title=Xavier SF Dailyn Swain plans to enter NCAA transfer portal |url=https://www.on3.com/college/xavier-musketeers/news/xavier-sf-dailyn-swain-plans-to-enter-ncaa-transfer-portal/ |website=On3 |access-date=24 March 2025 |language=en |date=24 March 2025}} ===Texas=== On April 1, 2025, Swain announced that he would transfer to [[Texas Longhorns men's basketball|Texas]].{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/texas/article/texas-basketball-lands-a-commitment-from-former-xavier-forward-dailyn-swain-248085286/|title=Texas basketball lands a commitment from former Xavier forward Dailyn Swain|website=247Sports|first=Eric|last=Henry|date=April 1, 2025|access-date=April 3, 2025}} On May 1, 2025, Swain signed an Athletic Scholarship Agreement to play basketball at [[Texas Longhorns men's basketball|Texas]].{{cite web |title=Men’s Basketball signs Dailyn Swain |url=https://texaslonghorns.com/news/2025/5/1/mens-basketball-mens-basketball-signs-dailyn-swain.aspx |website=University of Texas Athletics |access-date=12 June 2025 |language=en |date=9 June 2025}} In the first game against [[2025–26 Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team|Duke]], Swain made his Texas debut, recording 16 points, six rebounds, one assist, and one block.{{Cite web |title=Dailyn Swain Career Game Log |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/players/dailyn-swain-2/gamelog/ |access-date=November 6, 2025 |website=College Basketball at Sports-Reference.com |language=en}} On February 4, Swain was named to the [[Julius Erving Award]] Midseason Top 10.{{Cite web |date=February 4, 2026 |title=Men’s Basketball’s Swain selected to Julius Erving Award Midseason Top 10 |url=https://texaslonghorns.com/news/2026/2/4/mens-basketball-mens-basketballs-swain-selected-to-julius-erving-award-midseason-top-10 |access-date=February 4, 2026 |website=University of Texas Athletics}} On April 7, 2026, Swain took to [[Instagram]] to announce that he will be entering the 2026 NBA Draft and forgoing his college eligibility.{{cite web |title=Texas Longhorns’ Dailyn Swain Announces NBA Draft Decision |url=https://www.si.com/college/texas/basketball/texas-longhorns-dailyn-swain-announces-nba-draft-decision |website=[[Sports Illustrated]] |access-date=March 17, 2026 }}
